items.title: Microsoft Confirms Windows 11 Updates May Force Users to Enter BitLocker Recovery Key
items.description: Microsoft has officially acknowledged a known issue affecting Windows 11 users following the release of its April 2026 Patch Tuesday cumulative updates. Devices running certain BitLocker Group Policy configurations may unexpectedly prompt users to enter their BitLocker recovery key after installing updates KB5083769 or KB5082052. items.title: Microsoft Defender 0-Day Vulnerability “RedSun” Enables Full SYSTEM Access
items.description: A newly disclosed zero-day vulnerability in Microsoft Defender, dubbed “RedSun,” allows an unprivileged user to escalate privileges to full SYSTEM-level access on fully patched Windows 10, Windows 11, and Windows Server 2019 and later systems, and as of now, remains unpatched.
